# RR Free Tools distribution plan

Campaign: rr_free_tools

Use the clean canonical URL on the website. For external organic posts, append:
?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools

## Mining Diesel Cost & CO2 Calculator
A practical way to make diesel exposure visible. Enter annual fuel use, delivered price, production and an editable emissions factor to screen cost, carbon intensity and a reduction scenario. Free, no account required.
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/tools/diesel-cost-carbon/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools

## Solar + Battery Sizing Screener
A first-pass renewable-energy screen for industrial and remote operations. Estimate indicative solar DC capacity and battery energy from daily demand, solar resource, losses and autonomy assumptions before detailed engineering.
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/tools/solar-battery-sizing/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools

## Community Investment Prioritizer
Community investment should follow evidence, not visibility alone. Compare proposed initiatives using transparent ratings for community evidence, impact, urgency, reach and feasibility.
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/tools/community-investment-prioritizer/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools

## ESG Materiality Matrix Builder
A free structured starting point for organising ESG issues by stakeholder importance, business impact and evidence confidence. It is a screening tool, not a substitute for a formal materiality process.
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/tools/esg-materiality-matrix/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools

## Grievance Trend Analyzer
A privacy-first browser tool for anonymised grievance data. Review recurring categories, unresolved cases, severity and time-to-closure without uploading personal information.
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/tools/grievance-trend-analyzer/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools

## Executive 100-Day Plan Builder
A leadership transition is stronger when the first 100 days are organised around evidence, decision rights, stakeholders and measurable outcomes. This free tool turns a mandate into a structured 30/60/100-day plan.
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/tools/executive-100-day-plan/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools

## Government Meeting Brief Builder
Institutional engagement is stronger when facts, the decision sought, stakeholder sensitivities and commitment boundaries are clear before the meeting starts. Free browser-based briefing tool.
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/tools/government-meeting-brief/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools

## Responsible Procurement Self-Assessment
Procurement is part of ESG, governance and institutional credibility. This free assessment reviews supplier integrity, environment, worker protections, local supplier development, tender controls and evidence.
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/tools/responsible-procurement-assessment/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=rr_free_tools
